news.title: India Assumes CGGS Presidency — 5th Summit Confirmed for Chennai 2027
news.summary: At the closing of the 4th Coast Guard Global Summit in Rome, it was formally decided that India will host the 5th edition in 2027 — marking the first time CGGS is held in South Asia.
news.content: The handover ceremony at the 4th CGGS in Rome, Italy transferred the CGGS host presidency to India. The Indian Coast Guard will lead the 5th Coast Guard Global Summit in Chennai, coinciding with the Golden Jubilee of the Indian Coast Guard — 50 years of maritime service since 1977.
news.author: CGGS Secretariat

news.title: 4th CGGS Rome Sets Record — 115 Agencies from 99 Countries Participate
news.summary: The 4th Coast Guard Global Summit in Rome, Italy (10–12 September 2025) brought together 115 heads of coast guards and related organizations from 99 countries — the highest participation in CGGS history.
news.content: Co-chaired by Admiral Yoshio Seguchi of the Japan Coast Guard and the Commandant of the Italian Coast Guard, the summit operated under the theme of leveraging coast guard functions to enhance Maritime Domain Awareness. Leaders recalled the importance of strengthening cooperation, supported the promotion of the Online Program for Coast Guard Global Human Resource Development, and deepened understanding of MDA utilization cases worldwide.
news.author: Japan Coast Guard

news.title: Heads of Coast Guards from Seven Oceans Gather in Italy for 4th CGGS
news.summary: For the first time since its inception in 2017, the Coast Guard Global Summit is hosted outside Japan — in Rome, Italy, from 10–12 September 2025.
news.content: Launched in 2017 at the proposal of the Japan Coast Guard and The Nippon Foundation, CGGS serves as a forum for dialogue and cooperation where heads of the world's coast guard agencies gather to address global maritime challenges. The 4th edition in Rome marks a historic milestone as the first summit hosted by a European nation, bridging European and Indo-Pacific maritime security frameworks.
news.author: Japan Coast Guard

news.title: Over 115 Nations Confirm Participation — Record Delegation for CGGS 2027
news.summary: The 5th Coast Guard Global Summit is set to be the largest in its history, with delegations confirmed from over 115 nations and international organisations.
news.content: With registrations now open, CGGS 2027 has already received confirmations from coast guard chiefs and heads of delegation representing over 115 countries across Asia, Europe, the Americas and Africa.
news.author: CGGS Media Cell

news.title: International Coast Guard Fleet Review to be Held off Chennai Coast
news.summary: The International Coast Guard Fleet Review 2027 will feature warships and patrol vessels from participating nations in a grand maritime display off Marina Beach, Chennai.
news.content: The Fleet Review is set to be one of the most significant maritime events hosted by India, showcasing the collective strength and interoperability of global coast guard forces in the waters of the Bay of Bengal.
news.author: Fleet Review Committee

news.title: Golden Jubilee Gala: 50 Years of the Indian Coast Guard Celebrated at CGGS 2027
news.summary: The 5th CGGS coincides with the Golden Jubilee of the Indian Coast Guard, founded on February 1, 1977. Special commemorative events mark 50 years of maritime service.
news.content: The Indian Coast Guard celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2027, making the CGGS a doubly momentous occasion. The Golden Jubilee Gala Dinner on the evening of February 16 will be a historic event.
news.author: ICG Golden Jubilee Committee
